analysis:
Examined the base text of EngineV2Bridge+Submission.swift (units :2 and :3) with the patch excerpt. The PR adds a catch for MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngineError.unsupportedOutputControl in the non-throwing submitTokenized overload (head ~96-101). It also adds an early guard in the throwing overload (head ~153-157) that calls nativeOutputControlRefusal(request:tokenConstraint:). If that returns non-nil, it finalizes the cache lookup with .policy, finishes the continuation and throws. A new helper at head ~964-988 is truncated in the excerpt, so its body is not visible.

Security-relevant observations:
- The refusal runs after canSubmitWithNativeOwner() and before any reservation is taken: before the duplicate-id guard, serviceAllowance, pendingSubmissionIDs, prefix cache receipt minting, SSD staging and shared KV reservation. No resources are leaked on this path. The defers that release service allowance and pending state are registered later and do not need to run.
- usageSignal.finalizeLookup is called, so cache-lookup bookkeeping stays balanced and no ready receipt is registered at that point (T-041 receipt/staging release paths are untouched).
- The refusal message is a fixed marker, and the typed error is mapped back to a client 400 rather than a generic 500. This reduces the availability concern where a client could strike the coordinator's inference-error breaker (TB-002, T-010-style DoS) by sending logprobs or constraints. This is a positive change.
- The change touches no encryption, attestation, authorization or cache-scope logic. cacheScope is still coordinator-authored and unchanged.
- The throw happens before the duplicate-ID check, so an attacker cannot use it to affect another request's bookkeeping.

Open integration questions: (1) the full body of nativeOutputControlRefusal is not visible, so I could not confirm that its message contains no request content; the name and comment suggest a fixed marker. (2) Callers of the throwing overload and fromSchedulerMessage must handle the new unsupportedOutputControl case; the enum definition and callers are in other files, outside this batch. No concrete regression is identified.
